name: orchestrator-workers
context: Tasks where subtasks cannot be predicted in advance (for example, the number of files to change depends on the codebase): a central LLM dynamically decomposes and delegates, then synthesizes.
use_cases: Refactor across an unknown file set
anti_patterns: A static task list despite the dynamic label
Orchestrator context overflow from verbose worker outputs
Workers with overlapping scope causing non-deterministic routing
design_principles: Decompose along data and ownership boundaries
Workers return compact summaries, never full transcripts
Cap worker fan-out with maximum count per request
best_practices: Use tiered models: strong orchestrator, cheaper workers
Implement parallel worker execution for independent tasks
Log orchestrator plan, each dispatch, and summaries as discrete events
references: Wu et al., AutoGen: Enabling Next-Gen LLM Applications via Multi-Agent Conversation, 2023 — https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.08155
